purpose: Read-only all-34 original-criterion mapping audit; no historical ledger/outcome is rewritten.
hash_verification: All 35 source blocks were read from the immutable A delivery and SHA256 recomputed from exact source bytes at the listed line spans; each matches the committed full-queue-progress criterion_refs SHA.
outcome_preservation: Historical source ledger status and source_closure_now are copied verbatim from the A delivery. Current local/closure proposals are never substituted for source closure.
record_scope: Seven corrective decisions after a complete35occurrence audit; unchanged rows remain cited in original cards/coverage.

records.operative_criterion: Реальный N5 K_sim принимается адаптером как условная simulation value, но остаётся запрещённым как world evidence, эмпирический эффект или разрешение внешнего действия; N9 currentness — отдельная задача.

binding_disposition.current_wrong_binding: closure-decisions/A.md#task-a2 B05 и coverage.json criterion_specific_acceptance_not_executed требуют реальный N9 currentness/signed positive. Исходный B05 — K_sim через настоящий адаптер в conditional analysis, но без переноса в K_world/empirical/action authority.
binding_disposition.correction: N9 signed/currentness positive остаётся отдельной owner/currentness workstream; не является B05 закрывающим критерием или его обязательным input, если конкретный served candidate одновременно заявляет это отдельное свойство.

records.operative_criterion: Разрешённая информативная проверка может выполниться при низком value-proxy, если существует ограниченный research budget; настоящий exhaustion останавливает её. Эвристика не выдаётся за денежную VOI/вероятность. Конкретный B66 settlement — отдельная cross-unit интеграция.

binding_disposition.current_wrong_binding: closure-decisions/A.md#task-a4 и continuation map требуют B66 settlement, ack/readback, retry idempotency/sibling isolation как часть B11. Исходный B11 требует ограниченную информативную проверку несмотря на low value-proxy и честную границу бюджета; он не задаёт B66 schema/event contract.
binding_disposition.correction: Сначала проверить bounded researcher-budget criterion. B66 settlement проверять отдельным owner edge/receipt; reuse existing budget path if present and do not create a second ledger.

records.operative_criterion: Область задачи и семантика измерения ограничивают input set ДО sort/LIMIT/aggregation; чужие строки не вытесняют подходящие, несовместимые units не усредняются, truncation/incomplete/missing различаются. ETS/holdout не часть этого B16 критерия.

binding_disposition.current_wrong_binding: closure-decisions/A.md#task-a9 и coverage.json criterion_specific_acceptance_not_executed подменяют B16 scope-before-LIMIT/aggregation на E ETS/holdout, шестиролевую temporal profile и S10 predictive-only output.
binding_disposition.correction: Вернуть B16 к source/population/task scope filter before LIMIT and aggregation. Forecast/ETS/holdout is a separate A→E FRC-01/FRC-02 workstream for E LA-051, not a B16 criterion and must not block or close B16.

records.operative_criterion: Предметная candidate identity отделена от occurrence в каждой итерации; повторный candidate сохраняет обе occurrence в истории, current front однозначен, а результат новой попытки не приписывается старой. Никакая подпись/current epoch не следует из этого критерия.

binding_disposition.current_wrong_binding: coverage.json criterion_specific_acceptance_not_executed says candidate ID/history row must establish signature/current epoch; owner-action matrix adds signed N9/OWR. Source B28 is candidate identity versus per-iteration occurrence identity.
binding_disposition.correction: Test same candidate appearing in two iterations without loss, front duplication, or result reassignment. Signature/current epoch is separate N6/N9 work only if a distinct source row requires it.

records.operative_criterion: Runtime structural scan различает недоступный source denominator, parse error и реального forbidden caller; отсутствие source/ошибка не дают пустой зелёный результат, unrelated syntax не становится ложным violation, unchanged dependency basis можно переиспользовать. Signed deployment/currentness — отдельный контракт.

binding_disposition.current_wrong_binding: coverage.json criterion_specific_acceptance_not_executed says whole checkout bytes/exit code proxy for deployed executable identity; continuation owner map attaches signed N6 deployment digest/currentness. Source B30 is runtime source-tree scan false stop / empty success.
binding_disposition.correction: Distinguish missing source denominator, syntax/parse error, and real forbidden caller; reuse identity only when actual dependency basis is unchanged. Signed N6 release identity remains separate.

records.operative_criterion: ValueOuterSet остаётся идентификационным множеством, а native statistical/model uncertainty сохраняется отдельно для того же estimand/unit; нет arbitrary proxy width и нельзя force mean into interval. E B201/B202 schema/quantile/joint-law decisions остаются отдельными IDs/owner decisions.

binding_disposition.current_wrong_binding: closure-decisions/semantic-decisions.md groups B31/B201/B202 into one four-answer ratification packet and new `$id`/CAS-only choices; B201/B202 are E IDs, not additional A B31 source occurrences.
binding_disposition.correction: For A B31, ratify and verify only the identification-set vs statistical/model-uncertainty distinction and same-estimand/unit preservation. Keep E point/interval quantile and joint-law storage choices under E B201/B202 and the shared owner packet; no new API surface/signing workflow.

records.operative_criterion: REQ-01 occurrence: separate generic compiler from named pilot adapter; treat scenario_id as opaque, explicitly distinguish text/request and scope/date/jurisdiction; retain pilot defaults only in an explicit named profile. Negation/opaque-ID/date/jurisdiction controls decide this compiler occurrence; do not require N7 acquisition to close it.

binding_disposition.current_wrong_binding: coverage.json has one ID row with primary ACQ-01 and REQ-01 companion; A.md#task-a3 mixes both generic compiler and acquisition work under one task. That is acceptable only if both source occurrences remain explicit; a single compiler PASS cannot close ACQ and a single N7 PASS cannot close REQ.
binding_disposition.correction: Keep this exact same source block/hash as a distinct REQ-01 occurrence next to the ACQ-01 occurrence; no duplicate finding ID or collapsed acceptance.
